description.value: Bicycleitis is a small, independent bicycle shop located on Shawnigan Lake Road near Duncan on Vancouver Island. It describes itself on Facebook as 'the Small Shop,' suggesting a boutique or owner-operated character. Touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley area may find it a useful stop for bike-related needs.
